title: Live e2e specs form-view-subforms and grid-file-upload time out at the list's create button: matcher /^New$/i no longer matches its accessible name
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filing gate: ① a broken test with a named producer, found by the #36005 card thread while paying L1-d's S1 on PR #36233 (run against `df7a9112` on a CI-shaped rig: backend on :4010, console via vite preview). No product defect.

## What fails

Two specs in `ui/e2e/live/` fail before any of their own steps, timing out at `page.getByRole('button', { name: /^New$/i })`:
- `ui/e2e/live/form-view-subforms.spec.ts:29`
- `ui/e2e/live/grid-file-upload.spec.ts:45`

The list's create button no longer has exactly "New" as its accessible name. With the matcher relaxed to `/^New/i` in a throwaway local copy, both specs pass (2 passed). They are not in the PR CI lanes, so nothing caught it.

## Done when

- Both specs locate the create button by a stable handle (a test id, or the name the button has now), not an exact-text regex that a label change breaks.
- Confirm no other live spec uses an exact create-button name (on `main`, `git grep "name: /^New$/i"` finds only these two).
- Both specs pass in one run of the live lane; record the run.

Reader: `domain:ui` (e2e live lane). Related: #36005 (PR #36233).

Dedupe: `live e2e New button matcher`, `form-view-subforms timeout` (objectstack issues, open) → none.
